The 2nd and 3rd stage of Void Gravity is stuck because the second and 3 stages will cause additional damage after the target is damaged. However, the effect of Void Gravity does not disappear at this time, so the effect of damage caused by Void Gravity is triggered. , Thus infinite recursion, leading to stack overflow error.
Void Gravity does not currently have a sound effect, and one will be added later

notes.title: Add the close game button. Finally, you don't have to retreat
notes.notes:
An exit button is added in the player action scene, under the archive of the setting panel

In the battle scene, the close panel is added. The open panel button is on the left of the skill bar. Leaving and saving the archive before the battle can save the progress at the beginning of the battle. Pressing this button when your game card dies can save your file (if you forget to save before)
